text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day of Fine Motion's debut. She looks exhilarated in the lead-up to the race. Initially, I'm a little concerned that she won't take this seriously, but she puts my fears to rest quickly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion explains that she knows that she'll have even more fun the harder she tries to win. It looks like she's ready to give this race her all!
